name: XiaoAI Tools
description: Optional toolset that lets the xiaoai agent control the local XiaoAI gateway and media library service.

enabled.description: Enable or disable registration of XiaoAI tools.

gatewayBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the local XiaoAI gateway API.

libraryBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the local media library API.

bridgeBaseUrl.description: Legacy alias for gatewayBaseUrl. If libraryBaseUrl is omitted, this value is also used for media calls.

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for gateway and media-library tool calls in milliseconds.
